title: Launch video: creators talking to the device

segments.text: Got a bit of an idea that's interesting for a video, which is to sell the Ivy product itself. It's to get several creators and have them talking to the device with the hook being that the ideas are connected into
something like Mr. Beast's viral video that I was watching the other day on YouTube,

The video should be pretty short. I'm thinking that we have it in different hands and different people, and that the goal of the video is to make the product, then the AI, and then the output, and then a video all really seamless, all really fun.

And I think fun is the is the goal, is to make the UI and the AI really personable and really, I guess, optimistic around great ideas and talkative, and we can kind of show the visuals of that rather than lots of fun.
Like to have your thoughts on it and put together some ideas and storyboards and even some demo concepts.

cards.title: Several creators talking to the device
cards.gist: A video selling the Ivy product itself by filming several creators speaking to the device, hooked on how their ideas get connected.

cards.title: Borrow the viral YouTube video structure
cards.gist: She points to a widely shared YouTube video she watched recently as the structural reference for connecting the creators' ideas.
cards.their_idea: A viral YouTube video by a well-known creator that chains things together
cards.her_take: Use that same connective structure to link the creators' ideas in the Ivy video

cards.title: Short video, many hands, seamless flow
cards.gist: Keep it short with the device passing through different hands and people, moving seamlessly from product to AI to output to finished video.

loose_ends.text: Find the viral YouTube video she watched the other day to use as reference

requests.text: Give thoughts on the video concept and put together ideas, storyboards and some demo concepts.
